segment_contamination_dimensions: Agricultural/livestock use buyers (poultry farmers, cattle shed buyers) — sibling MCATs 'Poultry Sheds' and 'Cattle Sheds' serve a distinct agri-rural buyer persona incompatible with industrial factory shed buyers; names implying farm, poultry, or cattle use are blocked.

Residential/consumer portable structure buyers — sibling MCATs 'Portable Shelters', 'Portable Garage', 'Folding Garage', and 'Metal Sheds' serve home/personal-use buyers at a different price tier and use context; names implying portable, foldable, or home-garage use are blocked.

Specialised non-factory shed buyers — sibling MCATs 'Aircraft Hangars', 'Telecom Shelters', 'Military Shelters', 'Auditorium Roofing Shed', 'Badminton Court Roofing Shed', and 'Swimming Pool Shed/Tensile Cover' serve distinct end-use segments; names targeting these specific applications are blocked.

Warehouse-primary buyers — sibling MCAT 'Warehouse Sheds' carves out the warehousing/logistics sub-segment; names that primarily position the product as a warehouse shed (rather than factory/manufacturing shed) are blocked to avoid contaminating that sibling's buyer segment.

Tin shed / low-cost informal shed buyers — sibling MCAT 'Tin Shed' carves out the colloquial tin/GI sheet shed segment; the term 'tin shed' is removed from enhanced names and primary keywords to avoid collision, though it is retained in hindi_terms as a buyer vocabulary signal only.
